title: Identify the home team in the 'Netherlands Eredivisie' during the 2015/2016
question: Identify the home team in the 'Netherlands Eredivisie' during the 2015/2016 season that lost the fewest matches and also belongs to a team whose build-up play dribbling class is 'Normal' and chance creation passing is below the league average for that attribute in 2015.

prediction.sql:
SELECT t.XCL_173
FROM Team t
JOIN Match m ON t.XCL_171 = m.XCL_013
JOIN League l ON m.XCL_008 = l.XCL_003
WHERE l.XCL_005 = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'
  AND m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
  AND t.XCL_171 IN (
    SELECT ta.XCL_177
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    WHERE ta.XCL_182 = 'Normal'
      AND ta.XCL_183 < (
        SELECT AVG(ta2.XCL_183)
        FROM Team_Attributes ta2
        JOIN Team t2 ON ta2.XCL_177 = t2.XCL_171
        JOIN Match m2 ON t2.XCL_171 = m2.XCL_013
        JOIN League l2 ON m2.XCL_008 = l2.XCL_003
        WHERE l2.XCL_005 = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'
          AND m2.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
          AND SUBSTR(ta2.XCL_178, 1, 4) = '2015'
      )
      AND SUBSTR(ta.XCL_178, 1, 4) = '2015'
  )
GROUP BY t.XCL_171, t.XCL_173
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_015 < m.XCL_016 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT t.XCL_173
FROM Team t
JOIN Match m ON t.XCL_171 = m.XCL_013
JOIN League l ON m.XCL_008 = l.XCL_003
WHERE l.XCL_005 = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'
  AND m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
  AND t.XCL_171 IN (
    SELECT ta.XCL_177
    FROM Team_Attributes ta
    WHERE ta.XCL_182 = 'Normal'
      AND ta.XCL_183 < (
        SELECT AVG(ta2.XCL_183)
        FROM Team_Attributes ta2
        JOIN Team t2 ON ta2.XCL_177 = t2.XCL_171
        JOIN Match m2 ON t2.XCL_171 = m2.XCL_013
        JOIN League l2 ON m2.XCL_008 = l2.XCL_003
        WHERE l2.XCL_005 = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'
          AND m2.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
          AND SUBSTR(ta2.XCL_178, 1, 4) = '2015'
      )
      AND SUBSTR(ta.XCL_178, 1, 4) = '2015'
  )
GROUP BY t.XCL_171, t.XCL_173
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN m.XCL_015 < m.XCL_016 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ASC
LIMIT 1

FROM Team t
JOIN Match m ON t.XCL_171 = m.XCL_013
JOIN League l ON m.XCL_008 = l.XCL_003
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.XCL_171 = ta.XCL_177
WHERE l.XCL_005 = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'
  AND m.XCL_009 = '2015/2016'
  AND ta.XCL_182 = 'Normal'
  AND ta.XCL_187 < (
    SELECT AVG(ta2.XCL_187)
    FROM Team_Attributes ta2
